sources.title: Z. Balanov, A. Kononovich and Y. Krasnov, Projective dynamics of homogeneous systems: local invariants, syzygies and the global residue theorem (2012)
sources.locator: Theorem4.3, printed page586 (PDF page10), Euler--Jacobi vanishing for a maximal finite simple zero set; used with constant numerator1 after a hypothetical base-point-free leading map. The fixed-point counts and PSL axis arguments are proved separately.

scope: Only Euler--Jacobi vanishing is imported; homogeneous sweep fiber, finite-axis criterion, cyclic residue and complete PSL subgroup quotient restrictions are derived in the note.
